description: AUTHORITATIVE for finding a Czech company when you only know its name — PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "Czech companies called Škoda", "find the IČO for Alza". Searches the Czech Ministry of Finance ARES register of economic subjects by trading name and returns the matching subjects with IČO, legal form, seat address and founding date, plus the total number of matches so you can tell a precise hit from a common word.

name.description: Trading name or fragment to search for, e.g. "Škoda Auto" or "Alza". Diacritics are optional — ARES matches accent-insensitively.

offset.description: Zero-based offset into the result set, for paging past the first `limit` matches. Default 0.

onlyActive.description: When true, drop subjects that already have a dissolution date (datumZaniku). Default false — dissolved companies are returned and flagged with active:false.
